column1: # Both blocks keep their exact original WORD COUNT ($0D0A counts as a word),
# so the file length and every offset outside the block are untouched.
# Only the position of the newlines changes.
#     Tests: can $0D0A move inside a block, and does the dialogue window
#     grow to a width no line in the original block ever had?
#     Tests: can a block LOSE a line? The freed $0D0A becomes a text cell,
#     so the word count still matches. Watch whether the main CPU's
#     cols x lines x 64 DMA sizing keeps up when lines goes 3 -> 2.
